title: Text to Speech
summary: Free text-to-speech with natural Microsoft neural voices (falls back to the Mac's built-in voice offline), plus offline transcription of voice notes and recordings with Whisper.
how_to_use: Say "read it to me", "say that out loud", or "transcribe this voice note".
requires: macOS. pip install edge-tts for the good voices; whisper.cpp or openai-whisper for transcription.
